create_feedback: create a new feedback entry with type, rating data, metadata, and optional snapshot using the FeedbackTable.insert_new_feedback method
get_feedback_by_id: retrieve a single feedback record by its unique ID using FeedbackTable.get_feedback_by_id
list_feedbacks_paginated: list feedback items with pagination, filtering, and sorting by username, model_id, rating, or updated_at using FeedbackTable.get_feedback_items
get_leaderboard_data: fetch feedback data for leaderboard computation excluding snapshot and meta fields using FeedbackTable.get_feedbacks_for_leaderboard
get_model_evaluation_history: get daily win/loss counts for a specific model over the past N days using FeedbackTable.get_model_evaluation_history
